Preserve the restoration invariant rather than deleting it, and preserve trial preparation, forcing, seed, negative-drainage predicate, and Stage1-before-injection order. findings.finding: The starting observer does not report enough real milestones or typed error identity to distinguish numerical preparation refusal from injection and owning-domain refusal.
findings.evidence: It sets proposal_entered=true before transition_model and emits only result=typed_error on any post-initialization error. It does not separately establish proposal/Stage1 completion, negative-drainage injection application, owning trial-domain guard reach/refusal, or the concrete error variant and subproblem/refinement metadata. Initialization errors likewise omit concrete error identity.
findings.required_fix: Emit seam-derived milestones for initialization, proposal/Stage1 entry and completion, injection application, domain-guard reach/refusal, and controller return. Pre-injection errors must leave injection/domain/downstream milestones explicitly unreached. Emit the concrete typed controller error and available subproblem/refinement metadata without altering error precedence.

findings.finding: Initialization-error work needs a truthful split between controller Stage1 work and physical initialization activity.
findings.evidence: FoundationState::initialize creates state.work only after evaluator initial entry, phase selection, and raw-Jacobian assembly succeed. Therefore default M1TrustRegionWorkObservation is truthful on initialization Err only as controller/Stage1/refinement work. Evaluator/core/phase/Jacobian activity may already have occurred and cannot be described as total zero work.
findings.required_fix: Label the default object as controller/Stage1 work and separately report existing adapter/runtime/budget initialization observations or explicitly mark them partial/unavailable. Do not infer total zero initialization work. Post-initialization preparation failures must report the accumulated state.work.

findings.finding: A zero /proc/self/stat tick delta is presently representable as a resolved zero CPU cost.
findings.evidence: Process CPU is tick-quantized. cpu_delta_ticks=0 with cpu_delta_error=null does not establish zero cost, while the adopted authorization explicitly says unresolved CPU is not zero cost.
findings.required_fix: Report source, frequency and 1/frequency resolution; retain raw samples; expose resolved seconds only when supported. A zero delta must be marked below-resolution/unresolved rather than measured zero. Keep setup, getconf, CPU sampling, serialization, and build outside the monotonic proposal entry-to-return wall interval.

findings.finding: The endpoint record lacks explicit discarded-predictor status and overlap semantics required for actual-work interpretation.
findings.evidence: Existing work JSON exposes positive entries, factor applications, Dot2 rows/free gradients, scalar/guard categories and denials, but the cost record does not identify whether a predictor existed and was discarded, nor warn that refinement and whole-KKT/enclosure counters overlap.
findings.required_fix: Report predictor existence/discard only after the corresponding milestone, leave it unreached on pre-injection refusal, keep reservation bounds separate from actual work, and never sum overlapping refinement plus whole-KKT/enclosure categories into a false unique total.
